## PAQUETES 

```{r}
paquetes <- c("googlesheets4", "agricolae", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "readr")
nuevos_paquetes <- paquetes[!(paquetes %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(nuevos_paquetes)) install.packages(nuevos_paquetes)

library(googlesheets4)
library(agricolae)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
```


## DATOS

```{r}
url_sheet <- "[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LVnWoDJBeBvUv7nFfxwrUBfe_PvKVAzrVWY-9fU3IKQ/edit?usp=sharing](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LVnWoDJBeBvUv7nFfxwrUBfe_PvKVAzrVWY-9fU3IKQ/edit?usp=sharing)"
df_raw <- read_sheet(url_sheet, sheet = "fb")

```

## PROMEDIO

```{r}
df_dbca <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(b = as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", b))) %>%
  group_by(tratamiento, bloque) %>%
  summarise(b = mean(b, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    tratamiento = factor(tratamiento),
    bloque      = factor(bloque)
  )
```

## MODELO Y ANOVA

```{r}
modelo <- aov(b ~ bloque + tratamiento, data = df_dbca)
summary(modelo)
```

## COEFICIENTE DE VARIACION

```{r}
cm_error <- summary(modelo)[[1]]["Residuals", "Mean Sq"]
media_general <- mean(df_dbca$b)
cv <- (sqrt(cm_error) / media_general) * 100
cat(sprintf("\nCoeficiente de Variación (CV): %.2f%%\n", cv))
```

## COMPARACION DE MEDIAS 

```{r}
tukey_res <- HSD.test(modelo, "tratamiento", group = TRUE, console = TRUE)
```

## GRAFICA

```{r}
df_graph <- tukey_res$groups %>%
  rename(media = b, grupos = groups) %>%
  mutate(tratamiento = rownames(.)) %>%
  inner_join(
    df_dbca %>% group_by(tratamiento) %>% summarize(sd = sd(b, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = "tratamiento"
  )

ggplot(df_graph, aes(x = tratamiento, y = media, fill = tratamiento)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = media - sd, ymax = media + sd), width = 0.2, color = "gray30") +
  geom_text(aes(label = grupos, y = media + sd + 0.2), vjust = 0, fontface = "bold", size = 4.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Efecto de los Tratamientos sobre la Variable 'b'",
    subtitle = "Diseño DBCA (Prueba de Tukey, α = 0.05)",
    x = "Tratamientos",
    y = "Media de la Variable 'b'"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, max(df_graph$media + df_graph$sd) + 1.5)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```
